annotations.title: SEC Marketing Rule check of an investment adviser or fund manager ad, testimonial or endorsement, paragraph by paragraph (signed)

description: SEC Marketing Rule check for investment advisers and fund managers: send the text of one advertisement, testimonial or endorsement (up to 20,000 characters). Get one finding per paragraph of 17 CFR 275.206(4)-1 (general prohibitions (a)(1)-(7), testimonials and endorsements (b), third-party ratings (c), gross/net, 1-5-10 year periods, SEC approval, related, extracted, hypothetical and predecessor performance (d)) plus Advisers Act section 208, each with status flag | missing | check | found | not_triggered, the words that triggered it and the rule's words; what to keep under 17 CFR 275.204-2; sources with dates and a signed record. Optional facts the text cannot show: private_fund, performance_end_date, speaker, compensation. check_sources true also asks the eCFR for amendments after the reference dates (20 source checks an hour per caller). Fixed pattern checks, not a legal opinion; it never says an ad complies. Free: 120 calls an hour per caller. The tool stores nothing (the A2A door keeps a task copy 7 days). No model. Docs: https://llpro.ai/compliant-marketing-review-for

check_sources.description: Also read the eCFR version history of the two rules for amendments after the reference dates.

compensation.description: What the speaker was paid, cash or non-cash: none, de_minimis ($1,000 or less in the preceding 12 months) or over_1000.

performance_end_date.description: The date the performance periods shown end (YYYY-MM-DD), checked against the most recent calendar year-end.

private_fund.description: true if the performance shown is of a private fund (then the 1-, 5- and 10-year period rule (d)(2) does not apply). Default false.

speaker.description: Who gives the testimonial or endorsement: current_client (a testimonial), not_a_client (an endorsement), affiliate (a partner, officer, director, employee or control affiliate of the adviser).

text.description: The full text of one advertisement, testimonial or endorsement as it will be disseminated, including its footnotes and disclosures.
